regimeSub: 10Y rips to 5.28% (24yr high per Capital Brief) as bond selloff resumes post-NFP; inflation sticky at 3.7%.
themes: 10Y yield jumps 4bps to 5.28% (highest since 2002 per Capital Brief Oct 5) despite weak Sep NFP → bear steepener resumes as term premium reprices fiscal risk; Peter Schiff's 'mother of all bond bear markets' call gains traction
2s10s widens to -45bps (2Y +5bps to 4.83%, 10Y +4bps) as belly underperforms → curve steepening signals stagflation fears with CPI at 3.7% YoY (Aug) and core PCE at 3.0%, well above Warsh's 2% target
SPX grinds higher to 7773 (+0.6% DoD) as equity risk premium compresses vs 5%+ yields → VIX at 15.52 shows complacency despite Treasury turmoil; retail sales +1.1% MoM supports consumer narrative

Brent stabilizes at $100.81 (-1.4% from $102.25) as Saudi output normalizes post-Iran interim deal (Jun 14 per Atlantic Council) → gold at $4150 (-0.3%) as real rates rise with 10Y-inflation gap widening

headline: Treasury bear steepener resumes with 10Y at 5.28% (24-year high) as markets reassess term premium despite soft Sep NFP, while Warsh's Fed faces stagflation bind with CPI at 3.7% and core PCE at 3.0%.
